given_when_then.given: The Merchandiser is logged in and views the Product Catalog
given_when_then.when: The Merchandiser submits a new product entry with all required fields filled
given_when_then.then: The system creates the new entry, assigns it as the current version, and displays a success message

given_when_then.given: The Merchandiser attempts to update a product entry with a missing required field
given_when_then.when: The Merchandiser submits the update request
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the request and displays an error message indicating the missing field

given_when_then.given: The Merchandiser attempts to update a product entry that is in an archived state
given_when_then.when: The Merchandiser submits the update request
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the update and displays an error message indicating the entry cannot be updated due to its state

given_when_then.given: The Merchandiser submits a new product entry without a timestamp and user identifier
given_when_then.when: The system attempts to save the changes
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the save operation and displays an error message indicating that updates must include a timestamp and user identifier

given_when_then.given: The Merchandiser creates a new product version that conflicts with existing versions
given_when_then.when: The Merchandiser submits the update request
given_when_then.then: The system retains the previous versions and marks them as archived while creating the new version

success_criteria: The system prevents saving of catalog changes that do not meet defined business rules.
The system retains previous versions of products and marks them as archived upon new version publication.
The system rejects updates to archived product entries.
The system enforces mandatory fields for new product entries.
The system records timestamps and user identifiers for all product updates.
